data.name: AlertFileDescription
data.value: Configuración de señales de alerta personalizadas. El archivo seleccionado debe estar en formato WAV y ubicarse en la carpeta C:\Program Files (x86)\ATAS Platform\Sounds.

data.name: AlertFilterDescription
data.value: Notificación al alcanzar el nivel de volumen establecido manualmente.

data.name: CenterAlignDescription
data.value: Si está habilitado, alinea el texto al centro.

data.name: ClusterStatisticDescription
data.value: La plantilla permite obtener información completa sobre la estructura de cada barra.

data.name: ContrastTextDescription
data.value: Keeps the text color where it reads well and switches to white or black on the cells where it would not.

data.name: CustomSessionStart
data.value: Hora de inicio de sesión propia

data.name: CustomSessionStartDescription
data.value: Especifica el inicio de la sesión personalizada

data.name: FontSettingDescription
data.value: Describe varias configuraciones para la fuente.

data.name: GridColorDescription
data.value: Separación visual de datos para una lectura rápida de la información.

data.name: HeaderBackgroundDescription
data.value: Resaltado de encabezados para una navegación rápida por filas.

data.name: HideHeadersDescription
data.value: Si está habilitado, oculta las líneas de encabezado.

data.name: HighlightStrongCellsDescription
data.value: Draws an outline around the cells at the top of their scale.

data.name: ImbalanceMinDifferenceDescription
data.value: Minimum difference between the dominant and the diagonal volume for an imbalance.

data.name: ImbalanceMinDominantVolumeDescription
data.value: Minimum volume of the dominant side for an imbalance.

data.name: ImbalanceThresholdPercentDescription
data.value: Minimum ratio between the dominant volume and the diagonal one, in percent: 300 means 3 to 1. A diagonal with no volume is not compared.

data.name: LabelFillColorDescription
data.value: Configuración para una lectura cómoda de los datos.

data.name: LabelTextColorDescription
data.value: Establece el color del texto de la etiqueta.

data.name: NetImbalanceAlertDescription
data.value: Alerts when the net imbalance of a bar reaches the threshold, by absolute value, at most once per bar.

data.name: NetImbalanceAlertThresholdDescription
data.value: Net imbalance, buy or sell, that triggers the alert.

data.name: NetImbalanceAlertUseClosedCandleDescription
data.value: On: checks each bar once when it closes, and alerts if it reached the threshold and the previous bar did not. Off: alerts while the bar forms, when the net imbalance crosses the threshold.

data.name: RatiosAsPercentDescription
data.value: Shows Delta/Volume and Session Delta/Volume as a percentage (25%) or as a fraction (0.25).

data.name: SessionModeDescription
data.value: Representa uno de los modos de sesión.

data.name: ShowBuyImbalancesDescription
data.value: Buy imbalances of the bar: levels whose ask volume dominates the bid volume one level below.

data.name: ShowCandleDurationDescription
data.value: Información sobre la duración de la vela.

data.name: ShowCandleHeightDescription
data.value: Tamaño de la vela en ticks.

data.name: ShowCandleTimeDescription
data.value: Hora de inicio de la vela.

data.name: ShowDeltaChangeDescription
data.value: Cambio de dirección del mercado entre barras.

data.name: ShowDeltaDescription
data.value: Diferencia entre volúmenes en cada barra.

data.name: ShowDeltaPerVolumeDescription
data.value: Desequilibrio del delta en relación con el volumen total (%).

data.name: ShowMaximumDeltaDescription
data.value: Determina si se debe mostrar información sobre el delta máximo.

data.name: ShowMinimumDeltaDescription
data.value: Valor mínimo del delta durante la formación de la vela.

data.name: ShowNetImbalancesDescription
data.value: Buy imbalances minus sell imbalances of the bar.

data.name: ShowPeakDeltaPerSecDescription
data.value: Delta per second at the moment of the highest speed of the bar.

data.name: ShowPeakDeltaPerVolDescription
data.value: Delta share of the volume at the moment of the highest speed of the bar.

data.name: ShowPeakVolPerSecDescription
data.value: Highest speed of the tape in the bar: the volume of the last seconds (Time window) divided by the window, after each print.

data.name: ShowSellImbalancesDescription
data.value: Sell imbalances of the bar: levels whose bid volume dominates the ask volume one level above.

data.name: ShowSessionDeltaDescription
data.value: Desequilibrio acumulado de asks y bids desde el inicio de la sesión.

data.name: ShowSessionDeltaPerVolumeDescription
data.value: Desequilibrio del delta en relación con el volumen total del día.

data.name: ShowStackedBuyImbalancesDescription
data.value: Stacks of buy imbalances of the bar: runs of at least the minimum number of consecutive buy imbalance levels.

data.name: ShowStackedNetImbalancesDescription
data.value: Stacks of buy imbalances minus stacks of sell imbalances of the bar.

data.name: ShowStackedSellImbalancesDescription
data.value: Stacks of sell imbalances of the bar: runs of at least the minimum number of consecutive sell imbalance levels.

data.name: ShowTradesCountDescription
data.value: Información sobre el número de operaciones.

data.name: SotAutoFilterPeriodDescription
data.value: Closed bars in the mean of the peaks.

data.name: SotAutoFilterUseEmaDescription
data.value: Exponential mean of the peaks; off, simple mean.

data.name: SotMinVolumeDescription
data.value: A speed only counts when the window holds at least this volume.

data.name: SotTimeWindowSecDescription
data.value: Seconds of prints added up for the speed of the tape.

data.name: SotUseAutoFilterDescription
data.value: Colors the speed rows by how far each bar is above or below the mean of the recent bar peaks, instead of against the largest one.

data.name: StackedImbalanceMinLevelsDescription
data.value: Consecutive imbalance levels of the same side that make a stack.

data.name: TapeSessionsToLoadDescription
data.value: Sessions of prints loaded for the history of the speed rows, counting the current one. 0 loads the whole chart. Only requested while a speed row is shown.

data.name: UseAlertDescription
data.value: Notificaciones sobre eventos detectados por el indicador.

data.name: VisibleProportionDescription
data.value: Resaltado de datos con color solo en la ventana actual.

data.name: VolumeColorDescription
data.value: Establece el color del elemento de volumen.
